title: Production Deployment: Deploy to Production with Optimizations
problem_statement:
Design a production-ready Docker deployment with optimizations for security, performance, and monitoring. The deployment should include Dockerfile optimizations, security hardening, health checks, and CI/CD integration.

Requirements:

1. Dockerfile production optimizations:
   - Use multi-stage build with separate build and runtime stages
   - Use non-root user for running the application
   - Minimize layers and combine RUN commands
   - Use specific base image versions
   - Set appropriate permissions
   - Remove build artifacts in final stage

2. Security hardening:
   - Scan images for vulnerabilities (use Trivy or similar)
   - Use security scanning in CI/CD
   - Use secrets management (not in Dockerfile)
   - Use read-only root filesystem
   - Drop unnecessary Linux capabilities
   - Implement least privilege

3. Health checks:
   - Add HEALTHCHECK instruction to Dockerfile
   - Define health check endpoint in application
   - Configure health check in docker-compose
   - Set appropriate intervals and timeouts
   - Handle unhealthy containers

4. Resource limits:
   - Set memory limits in docker-compose
   - Set CPU limits in docker-compose
   - Configure logging driver
   - Configure log rotation

5. CI/CD integration:
   - Write Docker build and push commands for CI/CD
   - Configure image tagging strategy (git commit SHA, semantic version)
   - Configure automated testing before build
   - Configure deployment strategy (blue-green, rolling)

6. Monitoring and observability:
   - Configure metrics collection (Prometheus)
   - Configure logging (ELK stack or similar)
   - Configure tracing (Jaeger or similar)
   - Document monitoring setup
instructions: Submit exactly one file containing the production Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, health check implementation, and CI/CD configuration. Use === FILE: path === separators to separate files. Include deployment commands and monitoring setup in comments. Do not submit a folder or ZIP.

rubrics.full: Implements multi-stage build, non-root user, minimized layers, specific versions, and removes build artifacts.
rubrics.partial: Dockerfile has some optimizations but missing non-root user or build artifacts not removed.

rubrics.full: Implements image scanning, secrets management, read-only filesystem, dropped capabilities, and least privilege.
rubrics.partial: Some security measures exist but missing scanning or capabilities not dropped.

rubrics.full: Implements HEALTHCHECK instruction, health endpoint, resource limits (memory/CPU), and logging configuration.
rubrics.partial: Health checks or resource limits exist but incomplete.
rubrics.zero: Health checks or resource limits are missing.

rubrics.full: Configures CI/CD build/push, image tagging strategy, deployment strategy, and monitoring setup.
rubrics.partial: CI/CD or monitoring exists but incomplete or missing deployment strategy.

valid_alternatives: Use different CI/CD platform (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
Use different monitoring stack (Prometheus, CloudWatch, etc.).
Use different deployment strategy (canary, rolling, blue-green).
Add additional security measures if desired.
mistakes_to_check: Not using specific image versions (Version pinning).
